info.title: About this timeline
info.orderRelease: Titles in the order they came out. This is the order Marvel designed to discover the universe, surprises intact.
info.orderChrono: Titles in the order the story happens, from antiquity to today. Great for a rewatch. Some placements are debated, the title then shows a note.
info.sagasIntro: Marvel Studios splits the MCU into two large sagas, each built around a threat that grows from film to film.

sagaText.infinity: The Infinity Stones and Thanos, from the birth of Iron Man to Avengers: Endgame and its direct follow ups.
sagaText.multiverse: The fallout of Endgame and the opening of the multiverse, up to Avengers: Secret Wars.

info.phasesIntro: Each saga is split into phases, blocks of a few years that usually end with a big team up film.
info.erasIntro: In story order, the timeline is split by the main periods of the story rather than by phase.

typeText.series: Disney+ series, live action or animated. A series split across seasons can show up in several places.
typeText.short: The Marvel One-Shots, short bonus films released with the movies, and the Marvel Special Presentations.

legend.owned: In your library, ready to watch.
legend.progress: Started, the bar shows how far you got.
legend.played: Already watched, in Jellyfin or elsewhere.
legend.skipped: Skipped. Left out of the progression, the green line carries on over it.
legend.absent: Not in your library. You can request it from the top of the page.
legend.requested: Already requested, waiting to be added.
legend.upcoming: Not out yet, with its planned date.

info.keys: Arrows move from title to title, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter opens the title.
